summary.text: Judy Ward is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 30 since her election in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A registered nurse and former small business owner, she chairs the Senate Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Judy Ward is a registered nurse and a former small business owner, development professional and wellness coordinator for Ward Transport and Logistics, according to her official biography.
She served two terms in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, representing the 80th District, before her election to the Senate on November 6, 2018.

Ward chairs the Senate Transportation Committee and is vice chair of the Aging and Youth Committee, and she is a member of the Health and Human Services; State Government; Institutional Sustainability and Innovation; Rules and Executive Nominations; and Policy committees.
Her biography says her primary goals are to improve Pennsylvania's business climate, create jobs and advance economic and agricultural opportunities for the 30th District.
